title: Bubba's 33 to Donate 10% of Sales to South Texas Food Bank Tuesday
excerpt: Bubba's 33 in Laredo will donate 10% of all sales on Tuesday, Nov. 24, from 4 to 10 p.m. to the South Texas Food Bank to help feed families in need this Thanksgiving.
content:
Bubba's 33 in Laredo will donate 10% of all sales on Tuesday, Nov. 24, from 4 to 10 p.m. to the South Texas Food Bank.

The giveback runs during dinner hours at the restaurant, 5706 San Bernardo Ave., and is timed for Thanksgiving week to help feed families in need.

Diners can enjoy their favorite meals while helping local families this Thanksgiving season.
